purpose: Teach: アワ/ニャン/童貞/メヒコ/ペセタ/ルーシー/レヴィナス/スラブ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアワ、つまり徳島の粟料理のお取り寄せをされたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad ordered some awa — that's tokushima millet dishes, you know.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Gentle correction on the parenthetical, like she's explaining something small and sweet. Slight tilt toward conspiratorial—sharing what Dad did.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと家の猫が「ニャン」と鳴く動画撮ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I filmed this video with Dad where our cat meowed — it came out really cute.
lines.style: Bright, eager chatter. Quick tempo, words tumbling forward. Wants her immediate reaction. Eyes wide with the shared success of the moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「童貞期の青春小説は名作」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that coming-of-age novels about inexperience are real masterpieces.
lines.style: Gentle, slightly bemused. Delivers the odd observation with a knowing pause—she finds his taste endearing and a little bewildering. Soft, warm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとメキシコ、つまりメヒコ料理のレストラン行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to this Mexican restaurant with Dad — he calls it 'Mehico' — and it was so good.
lines.style: Rushing forward with the story. Mimics Dad's pronunciation with bright, innocent humor—not mocking, just sharing the family quirk. Wants credit for the outing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがコレクションの旧スペインペセタ硬貨を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed me some old Spanish peseta coins from his collection the other day.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly wistful. Paces slowly. There's warmth in recalling the small gesture—she's noticing his quiet generosity. Not grand, but real.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとピーナッツのルーシーのアニメ観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched this Peanuts anime with Lucy in it and it was hilarious.
lines.style: Bubbling energy. Slightly faster pace than the last. Can't wait to share the funny parts. Bouncy, alive. The kind of excitement that expects her to know why Lucy is inherently funny.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが哲学者レヴィナスの講義動画を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been watching these philosophy lecture videos — he's really into Levinas right now.
lines.style: Observant, slightly admiring. Gentle acceptance of his intellectual wanderings. Paced steadily, like she's quietly impressed even if she doesn't fully follow. Warm resignation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとスラブ系言語の比較表観たよ
lines.en: Mom, me and Dad looked at this comparison chart of Slavic languages together — it was so interesting.
lines.style: Eager, genuinely fascinated. Slower than the cat video, more thoughtful. He's sharing something he actually sat with Dad over—quieter pride. Wants her to understand why this mattered.
